title: Semiclassical localization of Schrödinger's eigenfunctions
summary: This article addresses the microlocalization of eigenfunctions for the semiclassical Schrödinger operator $-h^2Δ+V$ on closed Riemann surfaces with real bounded potentials. Our primary aim is to establish quantitative bounds on the spatial concentration of these eigenfunctions, extending classical results, typically restricted to smooth potentials, to the more general case where the potential is merely bounded.
